user.title: Connect to Kameraposti
user.description: Choose the service (test server cam.steels.me or production kameraposti.fi) and enter the MQTT login from Kameraposti’s sensor page (Cameras → Sensors → MQTT), e.g. kp-2 or the extra login kp-2-2, and its password. Just the account number (2) means the main login kp-2. Each login has one connection at a time: another Home Assistant or a bridge needs its own extra login.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Kameraposti
reauth_confirm.description: Kameraposti rejected the stored password. Create or change the MQTT password on Kameraposti's Sensors page and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Kameraposti broker. Check your network connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Kameraposti rejected these credentials. Check the account number and the MQTT password.
error.invalid_login: Unknown login. Type it as shown on the sensor page, e.g. kp-2 or kp-2-2 (or just the account number).

abort.already_configured: This Kameraposti account is already configured.

init.title: Sensors to Kameraposti
init.description: Choose the Home Assistant sensors that appear in Kameraposti and alarm through Kameraposti notifications: leak, smoke, gas (also carbon monoxide detectors and CO meters: alarm from 50 ppm, clear below 35 ppm), door, window, motion, temperature and CO₂ (carbon dioxide, ppm); at most {max}. Kameraposti creates them automatically. A sensor removed only in Kameraposti comes back on the next connection; remove it from this list too. A Z-Wave leak sensor is usually "…_water_leak" and a gas sensor has gas or carbon_monoxide in its name (shown as OK / Problem).

error.too_many: Kameraposti accepts at most 20 sensors per account.
error.unknown_kind: Could not tell whether these are leak, smoke, gas, door, window, motion, temperature or CO₂ sensors: {entities}. Remove them from the list.

locked.message: Too many wrong codes: disarming is locked (15 min, a day after repeated errors). Arming still works.

code_not_set.message: Set a disarm code in Kameraposti (Sensors → Security system) so Home Assistant can disarm.

no_response.message: Kameraposti did not answer. Try again.

refused.message: Kameraposti did not accept the change.

rate_limited.message: Too many commands in a short time. Wait a moment.
